adjudication.rationale: In `EmbeddableHost.record_for_host` the lookup uses `where("lower(host) = ?", host)` but assigns `host = uri.host` without downcasing it. If the incoming URL has a mixed-case hostname (e.g. `EvilTrout.com`), the SQL becomes `lower(host) = 'EvilTrout.com'`, which will not match a lowercased DB value unless the DB comparison is case-insensitive. This method is now used for embed host validation via `EmbeddableHost.host_allowed?` in both `lib/topic_retriever.rb` and `EmbedController#ensure_embeddable`, so it can cause valid hosts to be rejected.
